ruleInterpretations.WM025: Moon barrier is personal and only face up. Personal current vampires receive paid-reveal-only reduction using current personal secrecy; no face-up-play reduction. Personal winning contest observation survives source departure; resolve one influence per live region currently containing personal vampire characters, including valid dual-role attachments.
ruleInterpretations.WM024: Enemy includes both enemy seats in 2v2 (manual printed21), summed exposure. Both face-up play and paid reveal subtract 2 per enemy exposure with floor0 and unchanged loyalty. Reveal produces one additive Raid with event-time JC038 grant witnesses. Its printed X uses the current exposure when the damage effect resolves (ordinary effect timing, not a separately cited card-specific FAQ). Actual simultaneous lethal receipts retain dynamic renown; any such death causes exactly one draw in this effect, not a later death trigger.
